# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The following versions of Hunker Bunker are currently being supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please open a **Private Security Advisory** on GitHub rather than opening a public issue. 

1. Go to the [Security tab](../../security/advisories) in this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Provide a detailed description of the issue, steps to reproduce it, and any potential impact.

All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed. You can expect an initial response within 48 hours. If the vulnerability is accepted, we will work on a patch and notify you when the fix is deployed. We will publicly disclose the vulnerability only after a fix has been issued and sufficient time has passed for users to update.
